title: Component Standards
notes: GENERAL NOTE: The approved edition dates of these standards and specifications, along with the names and websites of the sponsoring organizations, are shown in Appendix E.

(1) Use of these standards does not require calculations in accordance with this Chapter. Where materials not listed in Appendix K are to be used, they need not be qualified as unlisted materials in accordance with para. K323.1.2. However, materials shall not exceed the upper temperature limit in para. K323.2.1 or para. K323.2.3.
(2) Piping components fully complying with these standards, including the pressure–temperature ratings contained therein, may be used, provided
(a) they meet the fluid service requirements in Parts 3 and 4 of this Chapter.
(b) they are examined and leak tested in accordance with the requirements of paras. K341 and K345, respectively.

(3) Use of these standards requires calculations in accordance with this Chapter. Where materials not listed in Appendix K are to be used, they shall be qualified as unlisted materials in accordance with para. K323.1.2.
(4) Piping components made in accordance with these standards may be used, provided
(a) their pressure design is in accordance with the requirements of para. K302.2.2(a).
(b) they meet the fluid service requirements in Parts 3 and 4 of this Chapter.
(c) they are examined and leak tested in accordance with the requirements of paras. K341 and K345, respectively.

(d) they are Charpy V‐no notch impact tested in accordance with the methods described in paras. K323.3.1 through K323.3.4 and meet the acceptance criteria specified in para. K323.3.5. Note that such impact testing may require the destruction of one component from the same lot as the component to be used in service [see Table K323.3.1-1, Note (1)].
(e) the upper temperature limit in para. K323.2.1 or para. K323.2.3 is not exceeded.
